author: Horse_Shoe_Crabcake
body:
With 100 AL at your main I would assume you've done endless before? Just pop some exp pots, wear exp gear with Oracle and 2 25% accessories amity. Then 5 dungeons+the menu dungeon. You'd comfortably reach max level with your alt. Especially if you have like lvl 3 dungeon anguish. 

All you need to do is be in a party with your alt and make good use of the "party exp share" feature of Orna. It makes it so that if your main (the one doing the endless runs) gets like 1 billion exp, the alt or any member of the party would get the exact same.

author: petr1petr
body:
fastest for me was doing raids together. 

as it is the best way (unless you are prepared with lower lvl char who can run endless)

1 raid in T9 really gives some 400M - but thats not less than 1% - you have your math wrong. lvl 225 needs 8-9B - that means 20-25 raids (1 raid = 4-5%)

so - I start solo for few minutes, I join my alt kingdom. I summon few bosses from remains. I do some dungeons together. as soon as I can, I will start raids - if I dont have any low tier raids available, I will switch to attuner and will do some kingdom raids. 

as soon as I hit 225, I just go endless with my main in party.

the issue with endless is, that you need to be max 25 lvl from each other - so your 250lvl main can not share exp with your lvl 220 alt.. If you know, that you will need to lvl up alt, you can set up one char to be lvl 225 and be able to run endless and you can use this one to carry your other alt.
